anomalies.observed: On the FCC sheet the VCAP pins (73,74) of the STM32H753VITx terminate on bare nets NET0117/NET0152 with no capacitor to GND; likewise on the NAVC sheet the VCAP_1/VCAP_2 pins of the STM32F405RGTx terminate on bare nets NET0092/NET0062 with no capacitor. The only 2.2 uF low-ESR capacitors on each MCU (C24/C33 on FCC, C44/C95 on NAVC) are wired to VREF+ instead, and the schematic text notes 'C13, C14: ESR < 100mOhm' (FCC) and 'C37, C38: ESR < 100mOhm' (NAVC) are orphaned - the components they name are not present on the VCAP pins.
anomalies.expected: Sound practice (and the ST reference design these notes describe) requires a 2.2 uF low-ESR decoupling capacitor from each VCAP pin to VSS for the MCU's internal core regulator; VREF+ needs only a small decoupling cap. The low-ESR 2.2 uF caps have been misplaced onto VREF+, leaving VCAP undecoupled.

evidence.quote: 'C13, C14: ESR < 100mOhm' with C24 2u2 / C33 2u2 drawn on VREF+-FCC; VCAP pins 73/74 -> NET0117 / NET0152 with no capacitor (FCC sheet, page 3)
'C37, C38: ESR < 100mOhm' with C44 2u2 / C95 2u2 drawn on VREF+; VCAP_1/VCAP_2 -> NET0092 / NET0062 with no capacitor (NAVC sheet, page 5)
FCC1 STM32H753VITx ... NAVC1 STM32F405RGTx (these parts require external VCAP decoupling capacitors)

anomalies.impact: The MCU internal regulator outputs (VCAP) are not decoupled, so the STM32H753 and STM32F405 may fail to power up, brown out, or run unstably; the board would not reliably boot or operate.

parsed.summary: The power stage, sensor set, I2C addresses (PCA9685 at 0x41 avoids the INA219 0x40 conflict), and the documented barometer RESET/EOC swap all match the spec, but the VCAP pins of both MCUs are left with bare net labels and no decoupling capacitors - the low-ESR 2.2 uF caps that the schematic's own 'C13,C14' / 'C37,C38: ESR<100mOhm' notes refer to have been placed on VREF+ instead, leaving the internal regulators undecoupled.
